To make a Conviction Check, each figure targeted by the Spell rolls
the Conviction dice printed on their card. If the total number rolled
is equal to or greater than the Spell’s Force Value, the Spell is resisted
by that figure. However, if their roll is less than the Force Value of the
Spell, the Spell’s printed effects occur. Once every target has rolled a
Conviction Check, the Spell Action ends.
Each target that failed their Conviction Check resolves the spell's
effects separately and in the order they made the Conviction Check. A
